Data (Key Fields): trip_id; duration; start_time; end_time; start_station; end_station; start_lat; start_lon; end_lat; end_lon; bike_id; plan_duration; trip_route_category; passholder_type; bike_type
Notes / Caveats: Coverage 2015 Q2 - 2026 Q2. Recommend restricting to 2022 Q1+ for schema consistency, post-COVID demand regime, and e-bike presence. Load as one continuous pass across quarters so bike_id continuity survives quarter boundaries. Drop 'Virtual Station' rows before building the ledger.

Data (Key Fields): Station ID; Station Name; Go live date; Status (Active/Inactive)
Notes / Caveats: Filename is date-stamped and changes on update; re-scrape the link from the Data page rather than hardcoding. Does NOT contain historical capacity.

Data (Key Fields): Feed auto-discovery; available feed URLs per language
Notes / Caveats: Resolve feed URLs from here at runtime rather than hardcoding child endpoints.

Data (Key Fields): station_id; name; lat; lon; capacity; region_id; rental_methods
Notes / Caveats: Reflects CURRENT capacity only. For historical windows use max(O(s,t)) over a rolling 90-day window as the empirical estimate and cross-check against this.

Data (Key Fields): num_bikes_available; num_ebikes_available; num_docks_available; num_docks_disabled; is_renting; is_returning; is_installed; last_reported
Notes / Caveats: Snapshot only - no historical archive is published. Start a 5-minute cron NOW in parallel with model development; 2-4 weeks of polling gives an overlap window against a future trip CSV release for validating the ledger.

Data (Key Fields): Station geometry plus status (legacy Indego-native feed)
Notes / Caveats: Field names differ from GBFS; needs its own parser. Lower priority.

Data (Key Fields): temperature_2m; apparent_temperature; precipitation; rain; snowfall; wind_speed_10m; wind_gusts_10m; relative_humidity_2m; cloud_cover; weather_code; sunrise; sunset
Notes / Caveats: SECONDARY to Open-Meteo Historical Forecast. Reanalysis format differs from the live Forecast API, which introduces train/serve skew if used as the primary training source.

Data (Key Fields): Same variable set and response format as the live Forecast API; continuous stitched hourly timeseries
Notes / Caveats: Coverage start (2021/2022) aligns well with the recommended 2022 Q1+ trip window. Join to station-hours on the hour in America/New_York; set timezone=America%2FNew_York to avoid UTC offset errors.

Data (Key Fields): current= and hourly= for the same variables; past_days= for recent backfill
Notes / Caveats: Forecast horizon limits how far ahead capacity can be predicted. Pin the variable list in config shared with the training job.

Data (Key Fields): Closure type; purpose of work; permit effective start date; permit effective end date; work status; geometry
Notes / Caveats: This is a CURRENT-STATE layer. Expired permits may be deleted, so historical depth degrades over time. Snapshot daily from day one to preserve history going forward.

Data (Key Fields): Same fields as Row 11, full snapshot
Notes / Caveats: CSV export is in EPSG:3857; GeoJSON in EPSG:4326. Reproject to a consistent CRS before any distance buffer, or buffer distances will be wrong by the Web Mercator scale factor (~1.29x at Philadelphia's latitude).

Data (Key Fields): Gas-main work closures; historical list method and current list method
Notes / Caveats: SOAP endpoint with two methods (historical and current) - the historical method is valuable because it gives real closure history rather than a snapshot. Requires a SOAP client, not plain REST.

Data (Key Fields): liveEvents; plannedEvents - incidents, roadwork, restrictions statewide
Notes / Caveats: Requires a Data Feed Request Form to obtain credentials - submit early, lead time is unknown. Live-only, so it has no training counterpart; treat as optional unless you archive it yourself.

Data (Key Fields): Bike lanes; connector streets; regional routes; trails and side paths
Notes / Caveats: Without this, closure features are noisy - most lane closures are irrelevant to bike traffic.

Data (Key Fields): Segment geometry; seg_id; street name; street class
Notes / Caveats: Layer 18 is 'Philadelphia Street Centerlines 2025' within the CityPhillyStreets MapServer. Requires a defined linkage rule (e.g. closure intersects a bike-network segment within 150m of a station) - this rule is a modelling decision, not a data property.

Data (Key Fields): hour_of_day; day_of_week; is_weekend; month; US federal holidays; Philadelphia local events; daylight flag; days since station go-live
Endpoint: No external endpoint - computed in-pipeline (Python 'holidays' library; daylight from daily=sunrise,sunset on the Open-Meteo endpoints)
Notes / Caveats: Covers the 'time of day and day of week' arm of the hypothesis. Generate identically in the training and inference paths from shared code to prevent skew. Timezone must be America/New_York throughout, including DST transitions.
